sources.title: GitHub - muhammad-talha-ad/LOCUS
sources.snippet: Locus uses the head as a speculative drafter for the model's own coordinate tokens. The draft is rendered as the tokens the model would write, and the same model checks all of them in parallel by Jacobi iteration, keeping the prefix it agrees with and correcting the next token until the draft stops changing.
